name: Netorareta Mama wa Suki Desu ka? ~Kyouiku Mama to Kateikyoushi~
original_name: ネトラレたママは好きですか？～教育ママと家庭教師～
source:
A friendly husband and a clever son. For Matsunami Kaori, her family is an irreplaceable treasure. Happy days that everyone envies. But ...

A calm and happy life begins to change little by little with something.
The reason? A young man she hires to be her son's tutor.

A wife and a mother who thought that her family was the best treasure begins to change when a young man reminds her that she is still a woman.

[Loosely Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=969797]Getchu[/url]]
